author: GGJJ
text:
Many thanks omidFxt for your charts. I also learnt a lot from them.
Especially I like the way you explained them from the IT's point of
view. That is what I need to understand.

Regarding the stop loss, your stop loss got hit because you did not look
 at the FL(spot on in this case). If the IT wanted to cause more pain,
would it be possible to even break the FL, and trigger more stop losses.
 If so, shall we add a few pips on top of the FL? If so, how many more
is sensible?

author: omidfxt
text:
hey GGJJ

thanks for your kind words. we all owe these to RTM

yeah i experienced what you are talking about and think it's better to
put the stop just a few pips above the FL and if there is a DP right
above the FL, put it above it because many time my stop hit just a few
pips above the FL and then went in my direction (i'm not enough
experienced yet and this is my idea from what i've learned yet )

But don't forget when the FL got engulfed and price went above the FL
even by a pip, the direction is changing. still price can retrace there
and we can get some pips but we have to know that price is going in the
direction of the engulf in future

and as always we have to consider the HTF and see the bigger picture

hope it make sense buddy

Regards

omidFxt
